title: Auditing LLM Editorial Bias in News Media Exposure

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the diversity, attention inequality (using the Gini index), and categorical composition of news outlets surfaced by LLM agents compared to Google News, identifying systematically promoted or silenced sources using Rank Turbulence Divergence (RTD).

Evaluating the ideological alignment of retrieved media outlets using the Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC) 7-point Likert scale (ranging from extreme-left to extreme-right) and comparing the political leaning of results across different LLMs using ANOVA and linear mixed-effects models.
